remarks: Discover the finest in Stamford living with this beautifully renovated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit. Located steps from a serene park and two schools, this home offers both convenience and charm. Enjoy elegant built-ins and a modern, stylish interior designed for comfort. Maintenance-free living includes heat, hot water, cooking gas and parking. This first-floor unit provides ample storage and easy access-no elevator needed. Perfectly positioned, you're just moments from downtown Stamford, Mill River Park, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Commuting is simple with Metro North and I-95 nearby.
